files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body: - Fixed the App Store registering the release as 0.4.2: the 0.4.3 tag was built from a commit whose info.xml still carried the old version, so no update was offered. This release ships the correct 0.4.4 metadata together with the light-mode readability fixes.
